blocks.text: You are under digital arrest. Stay on video call till inquiry is over.
Do not inform family. They are also under watch.
Transfer funds to RBI verification account. Will be returned in 24 hrs.

callouts: Real warrants are not sent on WhatsApp.
There is no digital arrest in Indian law.
Secrecy is how scammers keep you isolated.
No agency asks you to move money to prove innocence.

blocks.text: Traffic challan of ₹500 pending on your vehicle. Pay today to avoid court action.
Licence will be suspended in 24 hours

callouts: A deadline today is a pressure tactic.
Never install an APK from a message: it is malware.
Threats push you to act before you check.
